title: Introducing NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano Omni: Long-Context Multimodal Intelligence for Documents, Audio and Video Agents
brief: NVIDIA announced Nemotron 3 Nano Omni, a multimodal model that processes long-context documents, audio, and video for agent applications. The model represents a compact approach to omni-modal AI, combining text, audio, and video understanding in a single neural architecture.
